words.rule: Each side of a residential block is swept once a month on a set day, like the 2nd Tuesday: no parking 9 AM to noon or 12:30 to 3:30 PM, as the signs say.
words.afterpass: All year · not on City holidays (swept on the next scheduled day) · $73 ticket, no tow
words.dataNotes: The City's Residential Street Sweeping Schedule (Public Works; streets A to G and numbered streets from February 2018, H to Z from September 2025), 2,479 block sides placed on the City's street centerline by house number; the City's address points tell which side holds the odd numbers. The schedule says only AM or PM: the hours are the ones on the posted signs. Blocks that opted out of the program are not swept and are left off.
